# Cosmic Harmony: Reflections on God's Symmetry
## Scripture
"But God has made us a promise to adopt us as his own children, and to make us his heirs. He wanted us to know all about the glory that he has given to those who are his, and he wanted us to know about the great power that he has given to those who trust in him." - Ephesians 1:5 (GW)

## Reflection
As we gaze up at the night sky, we're struck by the symmetry and harmony that govern the celestial world. The orbits of planets, the phases of the moon, and the rhythms of the stars all reflect a deeper order and balance. This cosmic harmony is a reflection of God's character, who is the ultimate source of symmetry and beauty. Just as the universe is held together by physical laws, our lives are held together by God's promises and power. In Ephesians 1:5, we're reminded that God has adopted us as his own children and made us heirs of his glory. This promise is a source of comfort, strength, and inspiration, reminding us that we're part of a larger cosmic story.

## Prayer
Dear Heavenly Father, as we marvel at the harmony of the universe, we're reminded of your perfect symmetry and balance. Help us to trust in your promises and power, and to live in harmony with your will. May your glory shine through us, reflecting the beauty and order of the cosmos. Thank you for adopting us as your children and making us heirs of your glory. Amen.
